title: GeWu-Lab/DepthHelps-IROS2024
abstract: ## Depth Helps: Improving Pre-trained RGB-based Policy with Depth Information Injection Authors: [Xincheng Pang](https://github.com/pangxincheng)\*, [Wenke Xia](https://xwinks.github.io/)\*, [Zhigang Wang](https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=zh-CN&user=cw3EaAYAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate), [Bin Zhao](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=DQB0hqwAAAAJ&hl=zh-CN), [Di Hu](https://dtaoo.github.io/)‡, [Dong Wang](https://scholar.google.es/citations?user=dasL9V4AAAAJ&hl=zh-CN)‡, [Xuelong Li](https://iopen.nwpu.edu.cn/info/1329/1171.htm) The repo for "Depth Helps: Improving Pre-trained RGB-based Policy with Depth Information Injection", IROS 2024. Due to deleting a lot of useless code, there may be issues during runtime. If you have any questions, please open an issue or send an email to xinchengpang@ruc.edu.cn. #### Setup #### Dataset - Download the LIBERO dataset following [LIBERO](https://github.com/Lifelong-Robot-Learning/LIBERO) and put it in `data/LIBERO/v0` - Preprocess dataset #### Pretrained model - Download the pretrained model following [RoboFlamingo](https://github.com/RoboFlamingo/RoboFlamingo) and put it in `RoboFlamingo` #### Train Before train, we suggest that you check if your directory is consistent with the directory structure below. All of our experiments were trained using 4 NVIDIA A100. Please refernece to the `run.sh` #### Eval You need to install the `libero` following [LIBERO](https://github.com/Lifelong-Robot-Learning/LIBERO) #### Citation
abstract_zh: 作者：Xincheng Pang*、Wenke Xia*、Zhigang Wang、Bin Zhao、Di Hu‡、Dong Wang‡、Xuelong Li。本仓库对应论文“Depth Helps: Improving Pre-trained RGB-based Policy with Depth Information Injection”，发表于IROS 2024。由于删除了大量无用代码，运行时可能存在问题。如有任何疑问，请提交issue或发送邮件至xinchengpang@ruc.edu.cn。#### 设置 #### 数据集 - 按照LIBERO下载LIBERO数据集，并放置于`data/LIBERO/v0` - 预处理数据集 #### 预训练模型 - 按照RoboFlamingo下载预训练模型，并放置于`RoboFlamingo` #### 训练 训练前，建议检查目录是否与下方目录结构一致。我们所有实验均使用4块NVIDIA A100进行训练。请参考`run.sh` #### 评估 需要按照LIBERO安装`libero` #### 引用
tldr_zh: 通过注入深度信息改进预训练的RGB策略。
cover_zh: RGB策略不够用？注入深度信息，性能直接起飞！

judge.reason: IROS2024官方算法，通过深度信息注入提升预训练RGB策略，属于操作VLA方向，有实验支撑。
